entries.real_role: Namespace anchor — declares periphery.brody as a Python package. One-line comment asserting the Brody invariant: 'Brody responds, never decides. readonly=True always.' All 5 test files in this subsystem reach Brody source components via this package boundary.

Defines BrodyResponseContract dataclass with 8 governance invariants (readonly, advisory_only, context_signal_only, emits_act, emits_verdict, decision_authority, memory_write, kernel_mutation). validate() asserts all invariants with typed error messages (BRODY_CONTRACT_VIOLATION:*). BRODY_CONTRACT singleton is the canonical proof artifact imported by brody_runtime_readonly.py and all test files.
entries.claim_text: BRODY_CONTRACT is an immutable singleton with all governance invariants set to their safe values. validate() enforces these invariants at call time — called unconditionally by brody_respond().

entries.real_role: Defines BrodyResponse dataclass and brody_respond() function. brody_respond() calls BRODY_CONTRACT.validate() unconditionally before returning — making the governance contract a runtime invariant, not just a declaration. Returns BrodyResponse with readonly=True, emits_act=False, memory_write=False hardcoded at construction.
entries.contract_enforcement: BRODY_CONTRACT.validate() called at entry of brody_respond() — runtime enforcement of all 6 invariants on every call

entries.real_role: Defines BrodyContextQuery dataclass with readonly=True, memory_write=False hardcoded. build_context_query() factory function truncates query_text to 500 chars. No network call, no memory write, no model call. Defines the read-only query contract feeding into brody_respond().

Defines BrodyLanguageRoute dataclass with memory_write=False and route_brody_language() function. Supported languages: en, fr, es, de, pt, it. Routes unsupported languages to brody_default_chain. No decision emitted — routing is a mechanical mapping with no ACT.

Defines SanitizedResponse dataclass and sanitize_brody_response() function. _FORBIDDEN = {ALLOW, HOLD, BLOCK, ACT, DECIDE, VERDICT, AUTHORIZE, APPROVE} — 8 sovereign decision tokens redacted from any Brody output text. Enforces the boundary between advisory response and sovereign decision.
